title: Compact sources factor through a stage of a closed T1 chain
statement: Let $\lambda$ be a nonzero limit ordinal and $(X_\alpha)_{\alpha<\lambda}$ a continuous ordinal chain of topological spaces: at every nonzero limit $\beta<\lambda$, $X_\beta$ has the colimit topology. Suppose each successor map is a closed $T_1$ inclusion, meaning an injective continuous map which identifies its source with a closed subspace of its target and for which each point outside the image is closed in the target. Give $X=\operatorname{colim}_{\alpha<\lambda}X_\alpha$ the final topology on the set-theoretic union. Let $A$ be a compact topological space (every open cover has a finite subcover). Every continuous map $A\to X$ factors continuously through some $X_\alpha$. Equivalently, the canonical map $\operatorname{colim}_{\alpha<\lambda}\operatorname{Cont}(A,X_\alpha)\to\operatorname{Cont}(A,X)$ is bijective. Colimits are understood by the universal property of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].
